results.description:
War is coming… the world could be ending. And that's not even Tempest Merryweather's biggest problem.

There are rules she's sworn to live by—but she can't seem to stop breaking them.

As a healer and member of a secret and powerful coven, she has devoted her life to protecting those unable to protect themselves.

It's a lonely calling. One she answered without hesitation.

Until Fender walks into her clinic.

The injured hellhound should have been just another patient. Instead, he becomes the one temptation she can't heal herself from.

Still recovering from a devastating accident, Fender is stuck on the sidelines while his brothers prepare for war. When his alpha gives him an easy assignment, Tempest insists on helping, and with every stolen moment together, he finally sees the truth—the skittish little witch is his mate.

As the angels fall unsettlingly silent and a deadly virus spreads through the city, they set out to recover ancient weapons with the power to stop a coming war.

Instead, they discover a centuries-old evil has been unleashed, capable of bringing about total destruction.

But if they're not careful, it's the secrets Tempest vowed never to reveal that could destroy them first…
